findings.now: The toolbar offers Back, Validate, Save Draft, Revert to Draft and a disabled 'Manual / External Filing' button, and no control on the page queues the return.
findings.why: mark_submitted is defined at line 1684 but has no caller, although the registry now sets queue_submission: true for 2550Q.

options.name: Wire the existing action
options.detail: Add a 'Queue for submission' button that calls mark_submitted, as the 2552 page does at views/form_2552_view.rs:1443.

options.name: Replace the disabled button
options.detail: Swap the disabled 'Manual / External Filing' button for the queue action and keep manual filing in a note.

findings.now: Schedules 1, 3 and 4 are fixed at two rows each, with the note 'Additional sheets are not yet supported.' and no add control.
findings.why: The official 2550Qv2024 form grows these schedules through addlistSched1/3/4 popups, so a taxpayer with more entries cannot file them in the app.

options.name: Add and remove rows
options.detail: Add Add and Remove controls to each schedule, following the Add ATC Line pattern in the 2551Q page at views/form_2551q_view.rs:2338.

options.name: Explicit block
options.detail: Keep two rows but tell the user before drafting that extra entries must go on the official form, with the count shown.

findings.now: Schedule 1 and Schedule 3 entries are accepted without the official checks for purchase-date cut-off, source I/D, life of 1 to 60 and year 2000 or later.
findings.why: The official alerts 'Only dates on or before December 31, 2021 are allowed.', 'Accept only I and D', 'Invalid Input it should be 1 to 60' and 'Only values 2000 and beyond are allowed.' appear nowhere in crates/, and form_2550q.rs has no life or year range check.

options.name: Port the official checks
options.detail: Add the four alerts verbatim to the row validator so they appear in 'Draft needs review'.

options.name: Constrain the inputs
options.detail: Use an I/D picker and numeric limits so invalid values cannot be typed.

findings.now: The summary panel prints each error as 'field: message' using the validator key, so the user reads a key rather than the label shown on the page.
findings.why: The format!("{field}: {message}") call at line 1425 bypasses the on-page labels.

options.name: Label map
options.detail: Map each validator key to its visible label and print that label before the message.

options.name: Message only
options.detail: Show the official alert text alone, as the other pages do.

findings.now: The 'Evidence boundary' banner says queueing and submission transport remain disabled until separately certified, which contradicts the enabled queue.
findings.why: The freeze was lifted (crates/bir-core/src/forms/support_level.rs:358 sets queue_submission: true; commit 5aba8480), so the banner copy is stale.

options.name: Rewrite the banner
options.detail: State what the draft is proven for and what remains outside the evidence, such as schedule sheets and native PDF output.

options.name: Remove the banner
options.detail: Move the evidence limits to the release notes and drop the banner from the editor.

findings.now: Computed amounts round with Rust round() and display without thousands separators, so 1.005 shows as 1.00 where formatCurrency gives 1.01, and 1234567 shows as '₱ 1234567.00' instead of 1,234,567.00.
findings.why: money() uses (value * 100.0).round(), not formatCurrency's floor(x * 100 + 0.50000000001), and format_optional_money uses {:.2}; official_xml::official_amount (crates/bir-core/src/official_xml.rs:478) already implements the official rule.

options.name: Use official_amount
options.detail: Round computed rows with official_xml::official_amount and display its output unchanged.

options.name: Match the official rule
options.detail: Change money() to floor(x * 100 + 0.50000000001) and add thousands separators in format_optional_money.

findings.now: Items 19, 42, 47 and 56 each take one description and one amount, with no way to add a specify line.
findings.why: BIR-Form2550Qv2024.hta defines addColNo19/42/47/56 and addTblSpecifyNo19/42/47/56 popups, so the official form grows these items.

options.name: Add a row list
options.detail: Add a row list under each specify item, following the 2551Q Schedule 1 list.

options.name: Show the limit
options.detail: Keep one row and state that extra specify lines must be added on the official popup.

findings.now: Choice buttons keep the active look and pointer cursor even when the draft is locked, and a click does nothing with no feedback.
findings.why: render_choice has no disabled state, and apply_choice returns early when the editor is locked (views/form_2550q_view.rs:1286-1288).

options.name: Disabled style
options.detail: Pass the editable flag into render_choice and draw the disabled style, as the 2552 page's choice() helper does at views/form_2552_view.rs:576-595.

options.name: Locked note
options.detail: Show a 'Locked' note beside the choice groups when the draft cannot be edited.

findings.now: Eleven raw identity inputs (TIN segments, branch code, RDO, name, address, ZIP, contact, email and taxable year) are blank on a profile-derived draft, so the user must retype values the profile already holds.
findings.why: The page says these controls are blank on profile-derived drafts, yet new_from_profile already copies the TIN, RDO, name and address (crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_2550q.rs:917-935).

options.name: Prefill exact copies
options.detail: Copy each profile value into its raw input when the draft is created and mark it as profile-sourced.

options.name: Collapse the block
options.detail: Move the raw controls behind an 'Advanced' toggle so the main form stays short.
